issues: The word 'fair' can be recovered more narrowly as justice or equity than the full range of epieikes.
The phrase 'because you belong to Christ Jesus' makes the compact 'in Christ Jesus' relationship explicitly causal.
warning_disposition.decision: Retain both human-approved renderings. The verse 5 note discloses the wider range of gentleness, gracious restraint, reasonableness, and willingness not to insist on every right. The verse 7 note discloses the literal 'in Christ Jesus' form. All three auditors still found the unit eligible and no warning was blocking.
